fact: On 2 October 2025 the Gendarmerie nationale hosted the restitution workshop of ARHIP, a tool to aid the drafting and inter-service harmonisation of judicial and administrative procedures initiated under phase 2 of the EU Programme Opérationnel Conjoint (POC II), at which the tool was demonstrated, the procès-verbal models already drafted were shared, and how it would be put into use in the units of the security forces that draw up procès-verbaux was still under reflection.
title: Coopération UE-Sénégal : la Gendarmerie présente l'outil ARHIP pour harmoniser les procédures judiciaires
